summary: Waldencast plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting and disclosing board changes tied to the previously announced sale of Obagi Medical, expected to close in Q3 2026. The filing does not state a price per share, premium, or advisors. Post-sale, Waldencast will focus solely on Milk Makeup. This is a foreign private issuer report mapping to a material definitive agreement event. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb centers on execution of the Obagi sale and potential valuation of remaining assets.
